name: OnePlus OxygenOS
notes: OxygenOS 11+ is reported to ignore policy_control - if the bar does not hide, keep icon_blacklist + disable_flags (they are enough to blank the bar).
On builds that expose a vendor key, check `settings list global | grep -i policy` (older guides mention op_status_bar_policy_control).
Run `cmd statusbar help` - available flags depend on the Android version (system-icons/clock/notification-icons are the safe default).

hide.name: policy_control
hide.description: Enable immersive mode globally. NOTE: some builds ignore this key - see notes; icon_blacklist + disable_flags still strip the icons

hide.name: disable_flags
hide.cmd: cmd statusbar send-disable-flag system-icons clock notification-icons
hide.description: Suppress system, notification and clock icon groups (volatile, re-applied on boot)

status.name: icon_blacklist_size
status.description: Byte count of the blacklist (null/4 = key absent)
